payload.reason: The evidence discusses the impact of regularization in RR-based fingerprint construction on model performance and SNR, indicating that not applying RR could lead to lower SNR due to overfitting or underfitting.

claims.text: Not applying RR-based fingerprint construction may lead to lower signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) due to potential overfitting or underfitting of the model.
The performance of the model, including SNR, is sensitive to the selection of the regularization parameter λ, which is crucial for maintaining high SNR.
